article.headline: San Antonio faces Detroit, looks for 6th straight home win
article.description: Detroit Pistons (8-4, third in the Eastern Conference) vs. San Antonio Spurs (12-2, first in the Western Conference)
article.title: San Antonio faces Detroit, looks for 6th straight home win
article.linkText: San Antonio faces Detroit, looks for 6th straight home win
article.story: Detroit Pistons (8-4, third in the Eastern Conference) vs. San Antonio Spurs (12-2, first in the Western Conference) San Antonio; Tuesday, 8 p.m. EST BOTTOM LINE: San Antonio hosts Detroit aiming to continue its five-game home winning streak. The Spurs have gone 5-2 in home games. San Antonio ranks ninth in the NBA with 12.9 offensive rebounds per game led by Keldon Johnson averaging 2.4 offensive boards. The Pistons have gone 5-2 away from home. Detroit is ninth in the NBA with 32.3 defensive rebounds per game led by Ausar Thompson averaging 6.5. The Spurs make 46.8% of their shots from the field this season, which is 2.6 percentage points higher than the Pistons have allowed to their opponents (44.2%). The Pistons average 13.5 made 3-pointers per game this season, 0.7 more makes per game than the Spurs give up. TOP PERFORMERS: Victor Wembanyama is averaging 28.6 points, 11.6 rebounds, 3.3 assists and 4.3 blocks for the Spurs. Dylan Harper is averaging 18.3 points over the last 10 games. Thompson is averaging 10.1 points, 8.6 rebounds and 5.1 assists for the Pistons. Cade Cunningham is averaging 27.0 points and 5.6 rebounds while shooting 47.4% over the last 10 games. LAST 10 GAMES: Spurs: 10-0, averaging 119.7 points, 50.6 rebounds, 28.1 assists, 8.5 steals and 7.2 blocks per game while shooting 46.8% from the field. Their opponents have averaged 104.4 points per game. Pistons: 6-4, averaging 113.9 points, 43.1 rebounds, 27.1 assists, 9.8 steals and 6.5 blocks per game while shooting 45.7% from the field. Their opponents have averaged 109.9 points. INJURIES: Spurs: De'Aaron Fox: day to day (hip), Jayden Quaintance: out (knee), Tobias Harris: out (calf). Pistons: Jalen Duren: out (hamstring), Duncan Robinson: day to day (thigh), Isaiah Joe: day to day (hip). ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
